This event occurred before all Alaska data was archived at IRIS. The miniseed files for nearby stations was shared by the Alaska Earthquake Center. We have extracted waveforms from all stations within the maximum radius for which seismic waves were observable for this event, up to 600 km maximum, for 5 minutes before the event approximate start time and 5 minutes after the approximate end time. Metadata information for many stations is available at IRIS, but the metadata for the exact time period may or may not be present.

column1: SH? channels were all changed to EH? channels in the referenced files for consistency with how the stations are currently archived at IRIS. Note that the AV and AK network codes have switched for some stations now that they are archived at IRIS.
Files are named by STATION.NETWORK.LOCATION.CHANNEL.YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.m and are in miniseed format.

column4: Raw waveforms from closest stations. Data was demeaned but no other processing was applied. Dashed lines show approximate start and end times of event (from database). Figure generation is automated and there may be artifacts present.

High frequency (1-5 Hz) ground velocity waveforms for station response from closest stations with detections. Dashed lines show approximate start and end times of event (from database). Waveforms are corrected for station response after removing the mean. Figure generation is automated and there may be artifacts present. Clipped waveforms have not been removed before station correction so check raw plots before interpreting high amplitude signals.
Spectrograms of velocity waveforms corrected for station sensitivity from closest stations with detections. Figure generation is automated and there may be artifacts present

Multitaper spectra (same units as Power Spectral Density) of velocity waveforms corrected for station sensitivity from closest stations with detections. Linear trend was removed and a taper was applied before generating spectra. Figure generation is automated and there may be artifacts present. Since station response was not removed to avoid adding artifacts at low frequencies for short and intermediate period stations, the lower frequency amplitudes should be interpreted with care.
